sect1.title: DESCRIPTION
sect1.para: This TcpclV4BidirectionalLink virtual base class defines common functionality for version 4 of the TCP Convergence-Layer Protocol for the bidirectional nature of the TCPCL protocol, such that any "bundle source" must be prepared to receive bundles, and any "bundle sink" must be prepared to send bundles, and in both cases they must share the same underlying TCP socket/connection. This class can be compiled with or without OpenSSL support.
